name: Nesso_base
description: Firmware for the Arduino Nesso N1 (ESP32-C6) handheld controller. Features: clock/NTP, BLE scanner, WiFi scanner, LoRa (Meshtastic), IR remote (Flipper-compatible .ir files), RF433 sub-GHz, robot gamepad, media screens, web file manager, and serial command interface.
keywords: ESP32-C6, Nesso, N1, handheld, IR, BLE, LoRa, WiFi, RF433, Arduino
author: ugursayar
